date_text: Thu, Sep 3rd • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Sep 6th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: One of our firm favourites is back. Hop Nation are taking over all 12 taps on the Hotel Sweeney’s rooftop this Thursday and they’ve put together a seriously cracking line-up. From crisp pilsners and lagers through to juicy hops, nitro stout and the enormous 10.1% Kalash 2026, there’s plenty to work your way through. We always love seeing Hop Nation beers pouring at Sweeney’s, and with 12 of them hitting the rooftop at once, this is going to be a good one. Come thirsty. 🍻 Tap List: - Melbourne Black Nitro Pub Stout - 4.3% - The Chop 6% - Libba Legacy Lager - 4.4% - IPA Day '26 West Coast IPA - 6.5% - Caretaker's Cottage Czech Lager - 4% - Kalash 2026 – 10.1% - The Heart – 4.6% - J Juice - 7.1% - Rattenhund Pilsner - 4.8% - Melbourne Fog - 4.8% - Hop Nation Hazy Pale - 4.4% - MONA Pilsner - 4.5%
